owner.name: Joseph
owner.bio: Family-run crew out of Plant City. Joseph picks up his own phone — no call center, no dispatcher, just him.

hero.headline: Tree work, handled by the guy who answers his own phone.
hero.subheadline: Removal, trimming, stump grinding, storm and hazardous work — serving Plant City and the greater Tampa Bay area. Fill out the form and Joseph calls you back, usually within minutes.

services.name: Tree removal
services.description: Full takedown of trees that are too close, damaged, or in the way.

services.name: Oak trimming
services.description: Shape and thin oaks so they stay healthy and clear of your house.

services.name: Palm trimming
services.description: Clean dead fronds and seed pods before they drop or become a hazard.

services.name: Stump grinding
services.description: Grind stumps below grade so you can use the yard again.

services.name: Storm cleanup
services.description: Clear fallen trees and debris after Tampa Bay storms.

services.name: Hazardous removal
services.description: Careful takedown of leaning, split, or near-power-line trees.

services.name: Crane removal
services.description: Tight-access jobs where a crane is the safe way down.

services.name: Lot clearing
services.description: Clear trees and brush so a lot is ready to build or sell.
